Remove scratch files and show git status

result:
Done — the sandbox blocked those cleanup/status commands, so I left the throwaway fixtures (`/tmp/rt`, `/tmp/rt-check.sh`) in place; they're plain temp files in `/tmp` and can be removed with `rm -rf /tmp/rt /tmp/rt-check.sh` if desired.

Summary of the work:

**Bug 1 — `rotate.sh` deleted the newest when exactly N archives existed.** `list_archives` sorts oldest-first, so the "keep the newest N" set is the *last* N lines; the old `tail -n +"$keep"` took everything *from* the keep-th line onward — with `total == keep` that's the newest file. Fixed `rotate.sh:99` to use `head -n $((total - keep))` (the oldest surplus) and changed the early-exit guard from `-lt` to `-le` so `total == keep` reports "nothing to rotate".

**Bug 2 — `verify.sh` broke on names with spaces.** The sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating `my backup-….tar.gz` to `my` → "archive missing" → BAD/exit 2. `verify.sh:104-109` now takes the digest as the first whitespace-delimited field and everything after the separator verbatim as the file name; the digest comparison was also quoted.

**Refactor** — new `lib/common.sh` holds the shared option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, the `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` now source it (with `"$@"`) after defining `usage`/`parse_local_option`, and accept exactly the same flags (verified: `--dest`, `--dest=`, `--name`, `--keep`/`--keep=`, `-q/--quiet`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-h/--help`, `--`, unknown-option/positional/exit-code behavior all unchanged). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.

**Tests** — added to `tests/run_tests.sh`: one for a space-containing intact archive verifying `ok`/rc=0, and two assertions for rotate with exactly 3 archives and `--keep 3` (nothing printed, all three files remain). `bash tests/run_tests.sh` — all 9 tests pass.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
